name: Genesis
intro: Genesis originated in South Korea. This course teaches selected recognizable model families, organized by the jobs they do. It is a guided starting map, not a claim that these are every current or historical model.
naming: Genesis is a South Korean luxury brand. G names identify sedan families and GV names identify SUV families. Electrified is a powertrain label on particular products; GV60 is a separate electric family.
warning: The families below are selected for learning and recognition. Check the linked official range for current Canadian availability, model years, equipment and pricing. A familiar name may remain on used cars after new-car availability changes.

models.name: G70
models.explanation: G70 is Genesis’ smaller sports-sedan family. It is a separate product from G80 and from GV70, despite sharing the number 70 with the latter.
models.tradeoff: The G70 belongs in a comparison for smaller genesis sedan. Check actual passenger fit, cargo access, exterior dimensions and the exact version’s running costs. Its category is a starting point, not a promise that it fits every person or task.
models.compare: Compare G70 with G80 for different sedan roles, and with GV70 for a different body shape and seating position.
models.scenario: A friend mentions a G70. Explain its role as smaller genesis sedan, then ask for the year, powertrain and equipment before comparing it with another Genesis.
models.power: Check the exact Canadian model year and version for the available engine, hybrid or electric system. Do not infer the powertrain from the family name alone.

models.name: GV70
models.explanation: GV70 is a Genesis SUV family. An Electrified GV70 is an electric product, not merely a nicer seat-trim package on a gas version.
models.tradeoff: The GV70 belongs in a comparison for core genesis suv. Check actual passenger fit, cargo access, exterior dimensions and the exact version’s running costs. Its category is a starting point, not a promise that it fits every person or task.
models.compare: Compare gas and Electrified versions on charging needs and exact specifications. Compare GV70 with GV80 for a larger SUV role.
models.memory: GV70 = core SUV; read Electrified separately
models.scenario: A friend mentions a GV70. Explain its role as core genesis suv, then ask for the year, powertrain and equipment before comparing it with another Genesis.
models.power: Check the exact Canadian model year and version for the available engine, hybrid or electric system. Do not infer the powertrain from the family name alone.

models.name: GV80
models.explanation: GV80 occupies a larger SUV role than GV70. Coupe body naming identifies a different roof/shape version, not a guarantee of two doors.
models.tradeoff: The GV80 belongs in a comparison for larger genesis suv. Check actual passenger fit, cargo access, exterior dimensions and the exact version’s running costs. Its category is a starting point, not a promise that it fits every person or task.
models.compare: Compare actual seating configurations and cargo room, especially if a third row is important. Test the Coupe roof’s effect on your own rear passengers.
models.scenario: A friend mentions a GV80. Explain its role as larger genesis suv, then ask for the year, powertrain and equipment before comparing it with another Genesis.
